report.summary: Patient P-D012 (Hector Alvarado, 47, M) screened positive for food worry ("sometimes true") but not food running out; lives in low-income tract 17031230500 (Chicago) with high local food insecurity (40.9%) and SNAP participation (34.7%). Coverage: Medicaid (Lakeshore Community Health Plan), transport benefit yes. Submitted address and insurance to Harvest Table Pantry booking (awaiting contact). Four food-access options identified below.

options.name: Harvest Table Pantry
options.how_to_access: Address and insurance submitted via booking form; pantry will contact patient. Eligibility: appears to require address/insurance verification.

options.name: Northwest Side Food Pantry (fictional)
options.how_to_access: Open Mon/Wed/Fri 12-3 PM. No ID required. Fresh produce on Wednesdays.

options.name: Madison Street Community Fridge (fictional)
options.how_to_access: Open daily 8 AM-8 PM. Take what you need; no eligibility screening.

options.name: Saturday Market Pantry (fictional)
options.how_to_access: Saturdays 9 AM-noon. Cook County residents eligible.
